meta.name: FIFA+
meta.description:
Bringing fans into the heart of football with the iconic World Cup Archive, Live football from around the globe and documentaries bring the stories behind the beautiful game.

Shows: Morocco V Spain | Round Of 16 | Fifa World Cup Qatar 2022™ | Full Match Replay, Spain V Sweden | Semi-Finals | Fifa Women's World Cup Australia & New Zealand 2023™ | Full Match Replay, The Best Of Fifa World Cup Russia 2018™, 2010 Fifa World Cup South Africa™ | The Final, Fwc 2006, A Look Back: Italy
Available on: Samsung TV Plus
